jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary:
The Program Manager, Inventory Planning Strategy, is responsible for leading the assessment, design, documentation, and implementation of best-practice inventory planning capabilities across one or more functional domains. This role manages a portfolio of process improvement, automation, reporting, and system-enhancement initiatives from initial discovery through implementation and stabilization. The Program Manager partners closely with brand inventory leaders, subject matter experts, Technology, Business Intelligence, and change enablement partners to translate business needs into standardized processes, documented requirements, scalable solutions, and measurable implementation plans. The role serves as a domain lead and project owner, ensuring initiatives are appropriately scoped, prioritized, governed, and delivered.
Primary Functions:
- Conduct current-state assessments through workflow mapping, stakeholder interviews, data analysis, time studies, and gap assessments.
- Identify inefficiencies, inconsistencies, control gaps, and opportunities for standardization or automation.
- Facilitate cross-functional working sessions with brand inventory leaders and subject matter experts to define business requirements and future-state processes.
- Translate business needs into clear functional requirements, use cases, acceptance criteria, process controls, and implementation specifications.
- Partner with Technology, Business Intelligence, analytics, and other solution teams to evaluate solution options and support system enhancements, reporting capabilities, integrations, and automation.
- Provide the process documentation, subject-matter context, requirements, and implementation guidance needed to develop training materials, onboarding resources, playbooks, and support tools.
- Build strong partnerships across brands and functions while balancing enterprise standards with legitimate business-specific requirements.
- Support the ongoing prioritization of the Inventory Planning Strategy roadmap based on business impact, scalability, complexity, resource requirements, and strategic alignment.

Minimum Qualifications:
- 5+ or more years of experience in inventory planning, retail planning, business process design, supply chain transformation, program management, or a related discipline.
- Strong understanding of multiple inventory planning functions.
- Experience leading requirements-gathering sessions and translating business needs into solutions.
- Demonstrated ability to manage projects from discovery and design through implementation.
- Strong facilitation, written communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to partner effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Our Culture & Values
We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First
Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits
- A generous discount on all WSI brands
- A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities
- Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer
- Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits
- Tax-free commuter benefits
- A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health

Continued Learning
- In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University
- Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities
- Resources for self-development
- Advisor (Mentor) program
- Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series

WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).
This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.
Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.
The expected starting pay range for this position is $120,000-$135,000. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.

jobs.description:

About the Team
Our mission is to enhance the quality of our customers’ lives at home. We put the customer at the center of everything we do, every day. Our corporate values that guide our actions and decisions are our People First culture, customers, quality, shareholders, integrity, and corporate responsibility.

Overview of the Assistant Manager, OMNI Operations role
You will be driving incremental sales and ensuring profitability through the effective management of in-store order fulfillment via Omni channels. You will support management team in achieving goals by providing World-Class service. Serve as a role model for building relationships with guests. You will maintain presence through store supervision to ensure appropriate staff coverage in all areas of the store.

Responsibilities
·        Lead customer fulfillment across all channels leveraging all services (order pick up, outgoing shipment, Unpaid hold management, Home Delivery, Installation)
·        Identify, execute and maintain shipping in and shipping out lanes in the stock room. Utilize additional pop up tables, carts and or baker’s racks as needed
·        Ensure effective stockroom organization and supplies to maximize efficiency, safety and productivity to support salesfloor replenishment and Omni fulfillment
·        Perform regular audits and daily reconciliations (UPS, DIAR, Markdown Audit Report) and establishes daily disciplines to eliminate shrink (lost cartons, mis-picks, MOS, returns, RTVs)
·        Champions all safety best practices. Maintains and executes all safety binder requirements: hosting monthly safety meetings, ensuring tools and resources (ladders, box cutters, etc.) are in working condition, and ensures all associates have completed ladder safety training
·        Create and ensure a positive environment where all associates are treated fairly and with dignity in accordance with our People-First Philosophy

Criteria
·        Excellent communication, organization and leadership skills
·        Superior critical thinking skills to creatively identify challenges and develop action plans in a timely manner
·        Great time management skills and ability to execute multiple tasks and appropriately manage competing priorities
·       Ability to independently lead self and others to achieve results
·        2-3 years of previous retail sales experience or management experience in a customer service related field. Omni channel fulfillment experience a plus!

Physical Requirements
·        Must be able to be mobile on the sales floor for extended periods of time
·        Must be able to lift and mobilize medium to large items, up to 75 lbs., while utilizing appropriate equipment and safety techniques
·        Full time associates are expected to have open availability to meet the needs of the business.
·         Part-Time Flex associates must be available to work a minimum of two regularly scheduled shifts on the weekend** (Friday, Saturday and/or Sunday) and two during the week (Monday to Thursday). For an associate to be scheduled 20 hours or more weekly, greater availability (beyond the minimum required above) that meets the needs of the business will be required. **Weekend availability cannot fall on the same day; an associate must be available on two separate days (Friday and Saturday, Friday and Sunday or Saturday and Sunday).

·        A generous discount on all Williams-Sonoma, Inc. brands
·        A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities

·        Paid vacations and holidays (full-time)
·        Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits (full-time)
·        Cross-brand and cross-functional career opportunities
·        Online learning opportunities through brand specific resources and WSI University
Payrate: $24-$25/hr commensurate with experience

jobs.title: Store Operations Manager
jobs.location: Bondi Junction, New South Wales, Australia
jobs.description:
Williams-Sonoma & The Opportunity
Williams Sonoma is a multi-channel specialty retailer of high-quality products for the home. Our family of brands in Australia includes the well-known retailer’s west elm, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids & Williams-Sonoma.
We are looking for a dynamic Store Operations Manager to join our team in Bondi Junction. This is a Monday to Friday opportunity which involves overseeing stockroom operations, ensuring merchandise availability, and upholding WHS standards. The ideal candidate will excel in driving productivity and achieving company goals through effective inventory management.
Why You Will Love Working With Us
We are all about creating a workplace where you feel supported, inspired, and excited to come to work. Here’s just a taste of what you will enjoy as part of our team:
- Generous employee discounts so you can enjoy our amazing products
- Paid parental leave to support you through life’s most important milestones
- Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program for personal and professional support
- Career growth opportunities with real investment in your development
- A supportive, collaborative team culture where your success is celebrated
- The chance to be part of a fast-growing global business with an entrepreneurial spirit

What You Will Be Doing:
- Logistics Management: Plan and coordinate store deliveries while directing merchandise flow from the stockroom to the sales floor
- Inventory Control: Organize stockroom departments, maintain inventory records, and process paperwork like transfers and returns
- Back of House Operations: Maintain open and closing standards for Back of House (BOH) areas
- Customer Service: Provide exemplary service to both internal and external customers
- Productivity: Drive daily associate processing productivity in line with company standards
- Safety Compliance: Ensure daily compliance with Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) regulations

What You Will Bring to the Role:
- 2-3 years of management experience, preferably in specialty retail
- Strong leadership and organisational skills
- Effective communication and problem-solving abilities

Physical Requirements:
- Ability to be mobile in the store and back-of-house areas, including standing for long periods
- Ability to climb ladders and use other equipment in line with safety standards
- Ability to lift and mobilise medium to large items, up to 30kg, while utilising appropriate equipment and safety techniques

Ready to join the Team?
If you’re a motivated Retail Professional looking to take the next step in your career, apply today and make an impact as our next Operations Associate Manager!
Only candidates with work rights in Australia will be considered.


We are looking for a dynamic Stock Operations Manager to join our team in Bondi Junction. This is a Monday to Friday opportunity which involves overseeing stockroom operations, ensuring merchandise availability, and upholding WHS standards. The ideal candidate will excel in driving productivity and achieving company goals through effective inventory management.

We hope you're interested in building a home with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every requirement listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

About the Team

Our mission is to enhance the quality of our customers’ lives at home. We put the customer at the center of everything we do, every day. Our corporate values that guide our actions and decisions are our People First culture, customers, quality, shareholders, integrity, and corporate responsibility.

Overview of the General Manager role

You will hire great people and develop associates for future growth. You will provide leadership to achieve or exceed budgeted sales, payroll, and controllable expense goals. You will effectively manage store operations, maintain appropriate inventory levels, and maintain visual merchandising standards. You will ensure that all internal and external customers receive exemplary customer service and have a positive store/brand experience. You will ensure that sales associates build relationships with customers.

Responsibilities

·         Ensure store meets or exceeds sales and contest goals and meet payroll goals based on current trends

·         Prioritize, plan, and adjust schedules and daily agendas to meet business goals; hold team accountable to achieving goals

·         Train and motivate all associates through on-going programs in sales, customer service, and product knowledge

·         Assess performance and provide on-going feedback

·         Complete and deliver performance appraisals and development plans

·         Ensure team provides an exceptional customer experience in the store to achieve world-class service standards

·         Maintain presence through effective floor management and ensure staff coverage in all areas of the store as needed

·         Create and maintain an environment where all associates are treated fairly and with dignity and respect, in accordance with our “People First” philosophy

·         Work with District Managers and peers to develop best practices in store management

Criteria

·         Proven ability to manage staff to exceed sales goals, while meeting payroll goals

·         Proven to identify top talent, create teams, and train/develop/retain great people

·         Proven ability to think through complex issues, and allocate time to execute multiple tasks and changing priorities

·         Proven ability to motivate and influence others through personal actions and examples

·         Effective communication, organization and leadership skills

·         4 + years management experience in specialty retail and/or multi-unit retail business environment

Physical Requirements

·         Must be able to be mobile on the sales floor for extended periods of time

·         Must be able to lift and mobilize medium to large items, up to 75 lbs., while utilizing appropriate equipment and safety techniques

·         Employment/promotion to this role will be contingent on successful completion of a background check

·         Full time associates are expected to have open availability to meet the needs of the business.

Benefits Just for You

Depending on your position and your location, here are a few highlights of what you might be eligible for:

·         A generous discount on all Williams-Sonoma, Inc. brands

·         A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities

·         Paid vacations and holidays

·         Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits

·         A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health

Your Journey in Continued Learning

·         Individual development plans and career pathing conversations

·         Annual performance appraisals

·         Cross-brand and cross-functional career opportunities

·         Online learning opportunities through brand specific resources and WSI University

·         Leadership development opportunities

WSI will not commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position at this time (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

San Francisco Locations:

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

jobs.title: Tech Sr. Project Manager - Supply Chain
jobs.description:
About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.
https://www.williams-sonoma.com/
Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.
With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.
Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.
Located in Pune, the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center serves as a strategic engineering hub, driving innovation across e-commerce, supply chain, data platforms, AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, and customer experience technologies. Teams in Pune work closely with global business and technology partners to solve complex challenges, accelerate digital transformation, and deliver high-impact solutions at enterprise scale.
Role Overview
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Project Manager to lead complex, cross-functional technology projects across Supply Chain, Logistics, eCommerce Integrations, Order Management, Warehouse Management, Transportation, Merchandising, and Customer Experience domains.
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of successfully managing medium to large-scale technology projects, driving execution across multiple teams, managing dependencies, mitigating risks, and delivering business outcomes. This role requires strong project management fundamentals combined with experience supporting AI-enabled solutions, intelligent automation initiatives, analytics platforms, and emerging technologies that improve operational efficiency and business decision-making.
The Senior Project Manager will partner closely with Business, Product, Technology, Architecture, Data, and Vendor teams to ensure successful project delivery while maintaining visibility into scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risks.
Impact of the Role
- Lead complex, cross-functional technology projects across Supply Chain, Logistics, eCommerce Integrations, Order Management, Warehouse Management, Transportation, Merchandising, and Customer Experience domains.

- Drive execution across multiple teams by managing dependencies, mitigating risks, and delivering business outcomes.

- Improve operational efficiency and business decision-making through AI-enabled solutions, intelligent automation initiatives, analytics platforms, and emerging technologies.

- Maintain visibility into scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risks to ensure successful project delivery.

- Deliver on-time and on-budget projects while effectively managing scope, schedule, cost, and quality.

- Support successful implementation of Supply Chain and Logistics technology solutions.

- Improve operational efficiency through AI-enabled solutions and automation.

- Drive high stakeholder satisfaction and successful business outcomes.

Technology Platforms You Will Work On
- Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)

- Order Management Systems (OMS)

- Inventory Management Systems (IMS)

- Distribution Center and Hub Rollouts

- Transportation and Final Mile Initiatives

- Returns Processing Solutions

- Merchandising Systems

- Supply Chain Analytics Platforms

- Enterprise applications, cloud platforms, microservices, APIs, and third-party vendor solutions

- Generative AI, AI-powered automation, predictive analytics, machine learning solutions, and intelligent workflow automation

- Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Rally, and Smartsheet

- Power BI, Snowflake, and Analytics Platforms

- APIs, Microservices, and Integration Architectures

- Cloud-based enterprise applications

- Data visualization and operational reporting tools

Key Responsibilities
- Lead multiple cross-functional projects across Supply Chain, Logistics, eCommerce Integrations, Order Management, Warehouse Management, Transportation, Returns, and Merchandising domains.

- Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.

- Manage project scope, budget, forecasts, risks, issues, and resource requirements.

- Establish clear project governance, escalation paths, and communication plans.

- Produce meaningful status reports that clearly communicate project health, risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans.

- Drive accountability across business, technology, and vendor teams to ensure timely delivery.

- Manage projects supporting Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Order Management Systems (OMS), Inventory Management Systems (IMS), Distribution Center and Hub Rollouts, Transportation and Final Mile Initiatives, Returns Processing Solutions, Merchandising Systems, and Supply Chain Analytics Platforms.

- Coordinate integrations between enterprise applications, cloud platforms, microservices, APIs, and third-party vendor solutions.

- Manage dependencies between upstream and downstream systems to ensure successful end-to-end delivery.

- Manage delivery of AI-enabled business initiatives, intelligent automation projects, and analytics solutions.

- Support implementation of Generative AI, AI-powered automation, predictive analytics, and workflow optimization initiatives.

- Identify opportunities where AI and automation can improve operational efficiency, reporting, project visibility, and business processes.

- Partner with business and technical teams to define requirements, measure outcomes, and ensure successful adoption of AI-enabled capabilities.

- Support AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices as applicable.

- Perform project budgeting, forecasting, cost-benefit analysis, and financial tracking.

- Anticipate budget risks and proactively adjust forecasts.

- Manage Statements of Work (SOWs), vendor engagements, and third-party delivery partners.

- Hold vendors accountable for commitments, milestones, deliverables, and timelines.

- Utilize Agile, Hybrid, and Waterfall methodologies as appropriate.

- Drive planning, backlog management, release coordination, testing readiness, and implementation activities.

- Leverage Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Power BI, and reporting tools to manage project execution and provide visibility.

- Track project metrics, team velocity, risks, dependencies, and delivery trends.

Qualifications
- 10+ years of Project or Program Management experience.

- 8+ years of Supply Chain, Logistics, Retail, or eCommerce Integration technology experience.

- Proven experience managing multiple medium to large-scale cross-functional technology projects.

- Strong understanding of Warehouse Management, Order Management, Transportation Management, Inventory Management, and Merchandising systems.

- Experience managing enterprise application integrations and complex system implementations.

- Strong experience with project planning, forecasting, budgeting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.

- Experience participating in or managing projects involving Generative AI, AI-powered automation, predictive analytics, machine learning solutions, or intelligent workflow automation.

- Understanding of AI-enabled business solutions and automation opportunities within enterprise environments.

- Familiarity with Agentic AI concepts and AI governance practices is preferred.

- Experience with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Rally, and Smartsheet.

- Experience with Power BI, Snowflake, and Analytics Platforms.

- Experience with APIs, Microservices, and Integration Architectures.

- Experience with cloud-based enterprise applications.

- Experience with data visualization and operational reporting tools.

- Strong project planning and execution skills.

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive projects to completion.

- Strong collaboration, facilitation, negotiation, and influence skills.

- Hands-on approach with a strong focus on delivery and results.

- PMP, Agile, SAFe, or related certifications.

- Retail, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Omnichannel experience.

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Technology, Supply Chain, or related field.

Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center
- Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.

- Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership culture that empowers engineers to make real impact.

- Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.

- Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.

- Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of successfully managing medium to large-scale technology projects, driving execution across multiple teams, managing dependencies, mitigating risks, and delivering business outcomes. This role requires strong project management fundamentals combined with experience supporting AI-enabled solutions, intelligent automation initiatives, analytics platforms, and emerging technologies that improve operational efficiency and business decision-making.

The Senior Project Manager will partner closely with Business, Product, Technology, Architecture, Data, and Vendor teams to ensure successful project delivery while maintaining visibility into scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risks.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Brand Marketing - Global
jobs.description:
About the Team
The Global Marketing team drives revenue and brand performance across WSI's global brands through integrated marketing initiatives that increase awareness, engagement, and business results. Spanning social media, influencer marketing, PR, brand activations, and marketing operations, the team collaborates closely with brand, creative, e-commerce, merchandising, PR, and international teams to deliver cohesive, customer-focused campaigns.

About the Role
The Global Senior Marketing Manager leads the planning and execution of integrated marketing initiatives across international markets, with responsibility spanning cross-brand marketing, influencer marketing, paid social, PR, trade marketing, partnerships, and marketing operations.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating global and market priorities into clear marketing plans, targets, campaigns, and reporting. The Senior Manager works closely with leadership, e-commerce, creative, CRM, legal, finance, PR, and in-market teams to deliver cohesive marketing programs across Canada, Australia, and the UK.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, commercially minded, and collaborative marketer who can manage multiple markets and workstreams, build strong cross-functional relationships, use performance insights to inform decisions, and confidently lead projects from strategy through execution.

Responsibilities
- Lead cross-brand promotional and seasonal marketing strategy across international markets and brands, managing plans through cross-brand trackers, e-commerce meetings, business reviews, and other cross-functional forums.

- Partner with leadership to establish annual, quarterly, and monthly marketing, influencer, and social goals across key international markets; track performance and present marketing updates, results, and priorities in regular business reviews.

- Lead integrated market marketing initiatives across Canada, Australia, and the UK, partnering with e-commerce, creative, CRM, PR, legal, and in-market teams to deliver locally relevant campaigns and support strategic market priorities.

- Lead influencer marketing initiatives, including sourcing and managing high-profile partnerships, seasonal and niche influencer programs, and serving as a point of escalation for influencer communications and partnership needs.

- Oversee organic social strategy and execution across international markets, managing cross-brand briefs, identifying local content opportunities, partnering with creative and in-market teams, and providing social media best practices and platform guidance.

- Manage paid social campaign development across relevant markets, briefing creative teams and coordinating content, messaging, links, and campaign requirements with CRM and other partners for traffic and awareness initiatives.

- Lead international sweepstakes, trade marketing, and partner-marketing initiatives from conception through execution, collaborating with legal, e-commerce, CRM/EDM, creative, and external partners to maximize brand exposure and customer engagement.

- Manage key PR and brand activation workstreams, including in-store events, partnership and media outreach, PR requests, and escalation of customer or collaboration inquiries to the appropriate teams.

- Lead global marketing financial planning and oversight, including budget management, forecasting, accrual planning, and reconciliation; partner with Finance and the wider team to ensure accurate financial management and alignment of investment to marketing priorities.

- Analyze and communicate marketing, social, and influencer performance through regular reporting and roadmaps; contribute data and insights to quarterly reporting and use results to inform future campaigns, content, and marketing priorities.

Criteria
- Broad experience across integrated marketing, with strong working knowledge of Ecom, social media, influencer marketing, brand marketing, paid media, partnerships, PR, or related disciplines.

- Demonstrated ability to translate business and market priorities into actionable marketing strategies, goals, campaigns, and measurement plans.

- Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives across different brands, markets, functions, and timelines.

- Experience developing and managing influencer or external brand partnerships, including the confidence to manage senior or high-profile partners and resolve escalated issues professionally.

- Strong understanding of organic and paid social media, including content briefing, platform best practices, campaign execution, and performance analysis.

- Strong analytical and commercial skills, with experience setting targets, interpreting marketing performance, developing reporting, and translating results into clear recommendations.

- Experience managing marketing budgets and operational processes, including forecasting and financial reconciliation.

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate marketing plans, performance, priorities, and recommendations clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across e-commerce, creative, CRM, finance, legal, PR, and international teams as well as external agencies and partners.

- Proactive, flexible, and solutions-oriented, with strong ownership, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, multi-market environment.

- This role requires being onsite in SF office Monday through Thursday, with Friday optional in the office.

jobs.description:
About the Role
As an Associate Sourcing Manager, you will assist in the development and implementation of sourcing strategies, both short (seasonal/annual) and long term (3-5yrs) for the assigned product category(s). You will research, identify and develop production sourcing markets and suppliers that meet the product supply requirements of the assigned categories.
This role is in the Dumbo Brooklyn office 4x/week.

Responsibilities
- Collaborate with the design team and overseas offices/suppliers in assigned category(s) to:
- Execute creative designs
- Ensure product quality
- Meet on-time delivery
- Support speed to market
- Maximize profitability
- Minimize risk, e.g., diversifying country and supplier placement
- Understand the global landscape and opportunities
- Implement a product sourcing strategy in the assigned category(s) appropriate for each source region considering such factors as:  - Country competencies
- Supplier capabilities, capacities, and growth plans
- Country and vendor risk

- Partner with the design team during the development process to identify source markets and suppliers for requested materials, finishes, and products in the assigned product category(s).
- Manage sourcing processes and procedures in the assigned category(s) to successfully execute and deliver WSI products on time, which meet the design, quality, and value mission. This should include the following:  - Vendor Research and Development - Capabilities, capacity, and growth plans
- Material Research and Development
- Comparative Studies - Products, costs, and risk
- Cost Negotiations based on parameters from merchandising
- Production placement and reservations - (based on information from planning and merchandising)

- Troubleshoot seasonal product issues related to the development
- Focus efforts on the management of core and top seasonal investments
- Update and maintain accurate product information via our PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) system
- Partners with overseas offices and suppliers in managing the assigned category(s).
- A close working partnership with buyers, design, and inventory.
- Coordinates with all support areas on new developments: QA, Engineering, Testing, Inspections, Packaging, and Inventory.
- Close coordination with overseas offices, suppliers, and service providers.

Criteria
-  4+ years of college education (BA/BS)
- Minimum 2-year experience in offshore sourcing, buying/merchandising in a retail or manufacturing organization
- Strong knowledge of sourcing markets
- Travel required

You will be part of the Human Resources team responsible for supporting corporate client group functions. Our mission is to ensure that our clients are supported and fulfilled in their careers at Williams-Sonoma, Inc.

In the HR Generalist role, you will provide support for your internal clients and manage projects in support of the broader business. You will build collaborative partnerships with managers and associates by providing outstanding customer service and follow-through. This is a hands-on, solution-oriented role that helps drive business results by ensuring our ability to attract, engage, and develop the best talent in retail. You will also act as the data analyst and project coordinator for various HR projects. This role will support the Technology and Marketing organizations and other client groups as needed.

- Provide and Analyze HR Metrics: Track and analyze data regarding staffing, retention, turnover, exit interviews, and other information necessary and provide insights for talent discussions
- Ensure successful onboarding for new associates. Regularly facilitate New Hire Orientation and conduct onboarding sessions to ensure successful new hire integration
- Provide support for our recognition programs by managing the recognition program calendar, track and organizing nominations, and coordinating communication

jobs.title: Director, Partnerships and Brand Marketing - Pottery Barn Kids & Teen
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Director of Partnerships and Brand Marketing to lead the development of best-in-class product collaborations and partnerships that drive engagement, awareness, and revenue for the Pottery Barn Kids and Pottery Barn Teen brands. This role will partner closely with cross-functional teams to shape fully integrated 360° marketing campaigns, bringing together strategic storytelling, PR, content, digital, social, retail, and experiential moments.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead the development and execution of integrated 360° marketing and PR campaigns that bring collaboration partnerships to life across digital marketing, content, social, earned media, events, retail, and e-commerce.
- Serve as brand contact for collaboration partnerships, cultivating trusted, long-term relationships and ensuring partners are thoughtfully engaged from concept through launch.
- Partner closely with Merchandising, Creative, E-commerce, Inventory, Store Operations, Legal, and Brand Marketing teams to drive alignment, solve challenges, and ensure seamless execution across all channels.
- Own campaign planning and workflow management for Brand Marketing and PR initiatives, including timelines, deliverables, approvals, meeting agendas, launch milestones, and cross-functional follow-ups.
- Drive marketing operational excellence across complex partnership workstreams, including contract coordination, partner approvals, vendor onboarding, budget management, sample needs, asset delivery, reporting, and post-campaign recaps.
- Collaborate with internal and external teams to shape compelling storytelling, content strategy, press materials, partner messaging, and customer-facing launch narratives.
- Analyze campaign performance, press results, customer engagement, and partner impact to identify insights and recommendations that inform future collaboration strategy.
- Build and manage meaningful media relationships to support collaboration launches, brand campaigns, seasonal initiatives, and tentpole moments across Pottery Barn Kids and Pottery Barn Teen.
- Identify opportunities to amplify partnerships through culturally relevant moments, talent integration, events, press storytelling, social content, and brand-right experiential activations.

Qualifications
- 8-10 years of experience in partnerships, brand marketing, public relations, licensing, or talent, within a consumer-facing brand, retail, lifestyle, fashion, home, or agency environment.
- Proven track record of developing and executing high-impact partnerships, PR campaigns, brand activations, and cross-functional marketing initiatives that drive awareness, cultural relevance, and business results.
- Strong strategic judgment with the ability to identify brand-right opportunities, evaluate partnership potential, and translate cultural trends into meaningful consumer-facing programs.
- Exceptional relationship management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with senior leaders, cross-functional teams, collaborators, agencies, and external stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to lead complex, detail-oriented projects from concept through execution, including timelines, approvals, deliverables, budgets, reporting, and post-campaign recaps.
- Highly organized operator with the ability to manage multiple high-visibility initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong understanding of brand storytelling, earned media, influencer/talent strategy, consumer engagement, and culturally relevant marketing moments.
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
- This role is required to be onsite Mondays through Thursdays in our San Francisco office.

What You Bring
Strategic Attention to Detail: You understand that every touchpoint matters, from the first partner conversation to final campaign execution, and you ensure each detail reflects the highest standard for the brand.
Exceptional Communication & Relationship Management: You build trust quickly, communicate with clarity, and represent the brand thoughtfully with internal leaders, cross-functional partners, external collaborators, agencies, and talent teams.
Cross-Functional Leadership: You know how to bring teams together, create alignment, and guide complex initiatives across marketing, PR, creative, merchandising, legal, product development, and external partners.
Operational Excellence: You bring structure, discipline, and momentum to complex campaigns, managing timelines, approvals, deliverables, budgets, and competing priorities with precision.
Brand & Cultural Judgment: You have strong instincts for what feels brand-right, culturally relevant, and commercially meaningful, and can translate those instincts into thoughtful partnerships and campaigns.

Our Culture & Values

jobs.title: Social Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary
The Social Compliance Manager leads the execution of WSI’s factory social responsibility program across key suppliers and factories. This role manages social compliance audits, remediation, supplier training, and capacity-building efforts to support long-term improvements in responsible sourcing and factory performance. The Manager partners with vendors, factories, Brand teams, regional teams, and external stakeholders to ensure WSI expectations are understood, risks are addressed, and program standards are applied consistently.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead and execute WSI’s social responsibility program across assigned factories, vendors, and sourcing regions.
- Manage the third-party audit process, including audit scheduling, report review, corrective action tracking, performance monitoring, and cost management.
- Monitor factory remediation plans and provide guidance to vendors and factories to support timely, sustainable improvements.
- Assess audit findings, supplier performance trends, and key risk areas; escalate high-risk issues or potential crisis situations to management.
- Communicate WSI social responsibility requirements, protocols, and expectations to vendors, factories, Brand teams, and regional partners.
- Develop and deliver training to factories, vendors, and internal teams to increase awareness of WSI standards and remediation expectations.
- Provide guidance, direction, and support to associates, cross-functional partners, or external service providers involved in audit review, supplier follow-up, remediation tracking, and program execution.
- Support compliance with applicable local labor laws, human rights expectations, and supply chain due diligence requirements, including forced labor risk mitigation and traceability-related actions.
- Build strong relationships with internal and external partners to influence decisions, secure supplier commitment, and drive continuous improvement.
- Serve as a subject matter resource on local law requirements, social compliance best practices, remediation approaches, and responsible sourcing expectations.
- Support implementation and maintenance of audit databases, tracking tools, reporting processes, and supplier performance documentation.
- Research and recommend industry or regional best practices to strengthen WSI’s social responsibility program.
- Travel internationally as needed to support supplier engagement, training, audits, remediation, and regional alignment.

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in social responsibility, social compliance, responsible sourcing, supplier monitoring, or related work.
- 2+ years of management, leadership, project leadership, or indirect team oversight experience preferred.
- Strong knowledge of social compliance audit programs, corrective action management, factory remediation, and supplier capacity building.
- Experience with human rights due diligence, forced labor risk management, supply chain traceability, or responsible recruitment preferred.

jobs.title: Director – Enterprise Application Support (Supply Chain) | Hyderabad
jobs.description:
Director – Enterprise Application Support (Supply Chain)
Job Location - Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
Role Overview
- Leading application support teams responsible for enterprise eCommerce platforms and IBM Sterling OMS.
- The team monitors production Supplychain services, detects issues early, and resolves operational and functional issues.
- As the Director of Enterprise Application Support team, you will play a pivotal role in fostering a culture of continuous improvement while ensuring the robust performance of our systems in a highly transactional, global eCommerce environment.

The role requires deep technical expertise in eCommerce platforms, order management systems, specifically IBM Sterling, and supply chain operations
Impact of the Role
- Foster a culture of continuous improvement while ensuring robust system performance.
- Drive production stability and reliability throughout the year to prepare for peak-volume days and key events.
- Build urgency and accountability around customer problems and solve them quickly to minimize business loss.
- Improve operational efficiencies, supportability of new features, and overall system stability.
- Create a customer-first experience while ensuring high reliability and uptime.

Technology Platforms You Will Work On
- IBM Sterling Order Management System (OMS)
- Enterprise eCommerce platforms
- Supply Chain and Logistics systems
- Inventory Promising and Inventory Sourcing
- Payment Processing, Returns, MDM
- Microservices architecture
- Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, Datadog, New Relic
- PagerDuty, Opsgenie
- Enterprise Database platforms and database monitoring tools

Key Responsibilities
- Lead and manage cross skilled team of Application support responsible for supporting, maintaining and scaling eCommerce platform, IBM Sterling order management(OMS) and custom built microservices.
- Provide technical and functional leardership with deep knowledge in the above areas and contribute as a Supply Chain SME in product design, solution design, deployment, business reviwes and third party vendor tool assessment discussion.
- Think strategically to evaluate the current state and create and execute a roadmap to build operational efficiencies, improve supportability of new features, and ensure high stability
- Take a highly accountable, hands-on approach to coach and lead teams to actively fix issues and continuously identify patterns for larger problem-solving efforts to avoid repeat issues.
- Manage leadership communication and ensure priority issues are closed end to end, even when this requires working across teams.
- Work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Product, and Business teams to enhance system performance, optimize workflows, and improve product uptime.
- Develop and enforce disaster recovery and business continuity strategies to minimize service interruptions
- Build urgency and accountability around customer problems and solve them quickly to minimize business loss
- Apply technology and automation to improve monitoring, alerting, and issue resolution .
- Build strong teams with well-defined procedures and runbooks for triage and resolution.
- Build clearly defined and communicated SLAs, issue categories, points of contact, triage and decision trees, and hold teams accountable for them
- Develop and maintain a strong, real-time feedback loop with Development, Product, and Business teams to identify and implement improvements for issues that could be avoided through better design, coding, or monitoring
- Drive production stability and reliability efforts throughout the year to prepare for peak-volume days and key events
- Plan, organize, and manage assignments and operations by prioritizing and directing team activities
- Direct cross-functional teams using interactive and motivational leadership, including hiring, mentoring, performance appraisals, and career development.
- Mentor and guide senior engineers and managers, fostering a culture of growth, collaboration, and accountability
- Define team structure and recruitment strategies to build a strong, diverse team
- Remain highly attentive and responsive to communication
- Operate a computer and communicate via telephone.

Qualifications
- Technology delivery and production support expertise for large-scale omnichannel operations teams
- Experience managing a 24x7 enterprise support organization with the ability to drive incident management and root cause analysis.
- Proven track record of managing and scaling high-performing Operations teams, ideally in eCommerce, supply chain applications, or an enterprise-scale environment.
- Strong expertise in eCommerce platforms, IBM Sterling Order Management System (OMS), and integrated supply chain applications, including logistics, order fulfillment, and inventory management.
- Knowledge of transaction systems, inventory management, and order fulfillment processes
- 15+ years of total hands-on technology experience with a focus on design, development, testing, and support activities.
- 5+ years of manager-level experience in a similar function.
- Experience building, evolving, and coaching teams on technology and process improvements.
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Scope & Learnings
Lead enterprise-wide reliability initiatives, shape SRE strategy, drive automation and observability, mentor engineering leaders, and influence technology strategy across Williams-Sonoma's global Supply Chain ecosystem.
Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center
- Our people-first culture supports career growth and well-being.
- Fortune 500 scale with high ownership and global impact.
- Work on digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers.
- Continuous learning with AI-driven engineering opportunities.
- Flexible hybrid work model.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst I
jobs.description:
Overview of the role
We are seeking a dynamic, analytical person for the West Elm’s Brand Finance division.  This position is responsible for providing financial, analytical, and business decision support for short-term and long-term planning. An ideal candidate will bring financial experience, analytical capabilities, an eagerness to learn and collaborate, and an ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. This position reports into the Senior Manager of Brand Finance.

Responsibilities
- Develop annual budget and monthly forecast across assigned business channels, including shipping income and expenses, non-merchandise product costs and vendor/sourcing compliance-related expenses
- Manage month-end close process including journal entries, expense accruals, and variance analysis to reconcile actual results against forecast
- Own operating and general expense analysis and forecasting across assigned expense categories
- Own recurring financial reporting and KPI packages (quarterly, monthly, and weekly) for assigned areas of the business
- Create, prepare and continuously enhance key reporting packages for various brand partners to provide visibility into financial performance and drivers
- Identify and analyze ad hoc business issues, including vendor and contract-related initiatives, and collaborate with key partners across the organization to actively influence brand P&L performance
- Develop and maintain strong working relationships with business partners, communicating effectively in a variety of settings and ensuring partners are well informed and aligned with the brand's financial goals
- Support broader brand finance team by developing new tools to enhance financial modeling and analytics across the business
- Develop Powerpoint presentations for budget review, ad hoc brand initiatives, etc.

Criteria
- Love to work collaboratively in a group, you have an innate willingness to dig in and contribute with your team
- Are driven and motivated by the possibilities ahead
- Are a self-starter who appreciates challenges and takes initiative to improve the status quo
- Are a true business owner; comfortable with decision making and calculated risk taking for the benefit of your business
- Think innovation is critical in a business environment and support others in creative thinking
- Pride yourself on the quality of work and are a stickler for the details
- Challenge yourself and others to grow
- 1-4 years of experience in corporate finance, banking, accounting, planning, or similar technical analytical role
- Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a quantitative field (finance, economics, business)
- Strong analytical skills – extensive experience with Excel building financial models, forecasts and analysis from scratch
- Creative problem solving and strategic thinking skills – able to delve into business issues and large amounts of data to form insights and recommendations.
- Comfortable managing multiple projects with a high degree of ambiguity in a fast-paced setting.
- Results oriented – strong sense of urgency and excellent follow through.
- Solid interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills; ability to collaborate with non-financial partners and present a cohesive story to senior leaders
- Understanding of financial analysis concepts as well as a solid knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)
- Working knowledge of standard financial applications preferred: Hyperion (SmartView and Essbase), Oracle ERP, or equivalent
- Ability to work onsite in the Brooklyn office Monday - Thursday and work remotely on Fridays.

Our Culture & Values

jobs.description:
About Williams Sonoma DC - Memphis & Olive Branch

Since it was founded in 1956, Williams - Sonoma has grown from Chuck Williams’ single store in Sonoma, CA into one of the largest retailers in the country, with some best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings, including Williams – Sonoma. Pottery Barn and West Elm.

Our Distribution Centers serve as vital connections between factories and our retail, online and mail-order customers around the world. The Supply Chain environment is dynamic and fast-paced, and the network is expanding rapidly. If you have a background in distribution, manufacturing, engineering, transportation, finance, human resources or home delivery – and are looking for a job with a strong opportunity for gaining new skills and for advancement – our Supply Chain Organization could be just the place for you.

The Customs Compliance Analyst position may be located in Memphis, TN, The Colony, TX, Richmond, CA or Pompano Beach, FL. This position is responsible for ensuring corporate compliance to the rules and regulations of Customs and other government agencies while providing guidance to achieve lowest landed cost for a complex and broad product line. Determine HTS (HS) codes for a wide variety of products for four destination countries: United States, Canada, Australia, United Kingdom. Provide direction related to rules of origin for country-of-origin determination

You’ll be excited about this opportunity because....

- Perform analysis and documentation of both legal and factual information for classification of products for HTS(HS) to ensure smooth and accurate customs clearance and/or applicable special trade program qualification

- Maintain customs classification records to ensure company adherence with Customs rules and regulations and to demonstrate reasonable care

- Identify and address government agency requirements for imported or exported products.

- Respond to inquiries from Customs Brokers and resolve problems impacting import shipments. Research and provide information required for customs clearance

- Provide training to business partners as required. Contribute to user-friendly reference materials that support business and compliance requirements.

- Keep current with changes in regulations that impact classification and the Company’s product

- Understand acceptable methods of customs valuation

- Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure compliance with all relevant trade related laws and regulations while enabling the business to achieve objectives

- Manage a diverse workload which may include changes in priorities and responsibilities.

- Perform other duties as assigned

- At least 5 years or more experience working in the Customs organization of an US Importer

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Tools –Word, Excel, PowerPoint

jobs.title: Human Resource Specialist – Europe & Pakistan
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:
The HR Specialist shall provide proactive support to the HR Management team in the administration and proper maintenance of associate records and HRMS on a day-to-day basis and related human resource work relating to hiring, recruitment, training, compensation, promotion, termination, career development and/or retirement.
This position will be the first point of contact for Europe & Pakistan associates in operational HR matters.
He/she should also be aware and be kept abreast of the best market practices and updated with employment legislation to ensure Company HR practices are in compliance and work with their manager to update and maintain these policies

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Human Resources
- Maintains HRMS and leave records for Europe and Pakistan

- Maintain records and compile statistical reports concerning associate-related data such as hires, transfers, performance appraisals, opinion surveys, absenteeism rates and terminations.

- Ensure accurate and tracking of staff movement records, leave records as well as managing contents for employment documents.

- Administer and keep information on benefits and compensation packages up-to-date.

- Maintains company organization charts and any ad hoc reports as required by internal stakeholders.

- First point of contact in advising HR operational matters

- Administer employee recognition and staff engagement activities.

- Work with the Global HR team in updating the HR policy manuals and employee handbooks and ensure compliance with changing or new legislations.

- Support HR Manager in remuneration changes, performance management, talent management and other human resources processes and programs.

- Assist in facilitating new employee orientation program and other educational and training programs on changes in benefits, diversity, etc. to foster positive attitude toward organizational objectives.

- As part of the Global HR team, participate and support initiatives and projects

- Provide support on administrative tasks in the Istanbul office

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES:
- Candidate should possess a bachelor’s degree in HR or Business Administration, or related field with at least 2 years of relevant work experience in the HR field.

- Possess a good understanding of the Local Employment Act and practices.

- Has high standard of attention to detail and excellent communication skills.

- Solid commitment to customers or employee service.

- Strong Proficiency in Microsoft Office skills such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

- Ability to manage time and prioritize work.

- Experience in Oracle HRIS will be nice to have.

- Organized, with attention to detail and proficiency with numbers.

- Excellent communication and customer service skills.

- A high level of integrity and discretion handling confidential information as well as professionalism in dealing with associates and parties inside and outside of the company.

jobs.title: Sr Compliance Specialist - Security
jobs.description:
About the Team
Security Compliance helps to demonstrate the sustained compliance of the company with requirements for the protection of its high value systems and information assets. The scope of work extends across the corporate environment and its consumer delivery channels and it addresses legal requirements and industry standards such as PCIDSS, SOX, ISO, HIPAA, CA1386, and GDPR.

About the Role
The Sr Compliance Specialist - Security plays a lead role in this activity. The Specialist supports periodic updates to policies, standards and awareness materials, and is responsible for ongoing validation that key controls are implemented in a sound and sustained manner. The Specialist may identify potential security exceptions, help to resolve business requirements, escalate matters requiring management attention, and oversee timely and effective remediation of vulnerabilities in the security of company information. The Specialist also will be responsible for providing execution support to development teams and operations groups in performing risk assessments, due diligence activities, data management, ongoing oversight, and reporting related to their ongoing compliance with polices and technical standards.

The current role will focus on conducting internal PCI-DSS assessments in addition to assisting all business units and functional teams in-scope for external PCI-DSS compliance validation. The ideal candidate will demonstrate industry experience around compliance with PCI-DSS and related standards and will have excellent analytical skills with ability to identify non-compliant issues and ensure remediation of non-compliance using industry standard methodologies. You will assist in defining scope of the compliance assessment, ensure the intent of the PCI requirements are being adhered to, develop internal associates through PCI DSS educational opportunities and provide direct and specific mentorship to cultivate an efficient, innovative, and collaborative work environment. You will maintain productive, informative, working relationships with technical and management staff at all levels of the organization.

Responsibilities
- Plan, conduct and establish remediation plans for PCI Assessments.
- Actively engage business units at pre-determined times frame to provide a summary analysis of each business units compliance posture at checkpoints throughout the year.
- Identify and recommend changes in procedures, processes and scope of delivery needed to demonstrate sustained compliance with PCI requirements.
- Assist with PCI-DSS compliance checklists including review and validation of existing controls, documentation and any potential gaps.
- Provide management guidance and expertise for all PCI gaps and help to prioritize remediation targets.
- Reduce demand on resource Owners for evidence collection and analysis via use of GRC and related security tools.
- Reduce the company’s overall PCI-DSS scope where possible via taking lead on remote scoping practices and procedures.
- Provide remediation guidance to technical teams to establish and maintain sustained compliance with PCI-DSS.
- Provide long-term cost-effective remediation solutions/recommendations to address systemic issues or gaps that potentially risk corporate PCI-DSS Compliance.

Criteria
- BA/BS or equivalent experience, with 7+ years’ experience gained in the information security field
- CISSP, CISM, CISA or similar certification [e.g., GIAC Certified ISO-17799 Specialist (G7799)]
- 5+ years’ experience in a PCI support role or engineering position experience required
- Extensive knowledge and experience with information security standards and methodologies, including the PCIDSS, ISO 9000 series, COBIT, Sarbanes Oxley, HIPAA, and other relevant industry security standards, and an in-depth knowledge of risk assessment and risk analysis
- QSA or ISA strongly preferred
- Experience in an enterprise-class Technology organization, working with large scale Distributed Systems environments preferred
- Excellent written and verbal communications skills
- Leadership role in previous job experience
- Results oriented, self-motivated
- Experience working with, and ideally writing, information security policies and standards and/or developing or implementing security-related tools preferred
- Understand information security holistically and how it relates to business goals preferred
- Ability to design, implement, reengineer and manage complex processes preferred
- Privacy Certification (e.g., Certified Information Privacy Professional) preferred
- Experience interfacing with and communicating information on complex privacy and security compliance issues to senior management and business units and external parties preferred
- Experience presenting IT security issues to large audiences, forums, or communities preferred
- Experience working within the retail sector preferred
- This role requires being onsite in the Rocklin, CA office Monday through Thursday

Our Culture & Values
We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First
Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits
- A generous discount on all WSI brands

- A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities

- Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer

- Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits

- Tax-free commuter benefits

- A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health

Continued Learning
- In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University

- Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities

- Resources for self-development

- Advisor (Mentor) program

- Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series
